item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R09-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R09-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R09-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R09-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R09-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The 2023 budget plan provided for €166.23 billion in expenditure for the Federal Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs, €282.6 billion in grants and transfers versus €354.2 billion in 2022, and €7.3 billion in loans to the IMF Resilience and Sustainability Trust and the health fund.","notes":["The excerpt describes planned or budgeted amounts, not necessarily enacted or executed allocations."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R09-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Bundestag adopted the 2023 budget by 379 votes to 283; opposition speakers criticized the budget, while coalition-party speakers expressed support.","notes":["The excerpt does not state that there were zero abstentions.","The coalition-wide characterization and the specific summary of its description are broader than the excerpt; the excerpt reports statements by named coalition-party speakers."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0034-R09-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The recorded vote adopted the 2023 budget by 379 votes to 283, with zero abstentions, and six opposition resolutions were rejected.","notes":["The excerpt supports the vote result, zero abstentions, adoption, and rejection of six resolutions, but does not explicitly characterize the vote as a final or third-reading vote."]}]}
